import.heading: 📥 Bulk Import Products
import.subheading: Upload a CSV file to create up to {max} listings in one go.
import.fileFormat: A .csv file (comma-separated values) — the kind Excel, Numbers and Google Sheets all export. The first row must be the column names.
import.fileRows: One product per row, up to {max} rows per file.
import.fileNoImages: Photos cannot be imported. Listings arrive without a picture — open each one afterwards to add photos.
import.noteTitle: The product name buyers will see.
import.notePrice: A number above 0, in RM. Do not include a currency symbol.
import.valuesTitle: ✅ These three columns must match exactly
import.valuesHint: Spelling and capitalisation must match one of the options below, otherwise the listing is created but will not show up under that filter.
import.step1: Download the template and fill in one product per row.
import.step2: Upload the file to preview and validate it.
import.step3: Import — every row must be valid; the import is all-or-nothing.
import.requiredNote: Required columns: title, price. Optional: description, category, condition, stockQuantity, location, dealingMethod, phoneNumber, originalPrice.
import.emptyFile: No data rows found in this file.
import.missingColumns: The file must contain 'title' and 'price' columns.
import.tooManyRows: Too many rows — the maximum per import is {max}.
import.fixErrors: Fix the rows marked in red — nothing is imported until every row is valid.
import.errPriceInvalid: price must be a number greater than 0
import.errStockInvalid: stockQuantity must be a whole number of at least 1
import.errOriginalPriceInvalid: originalPrice must be a number greater than 0
